evaluator.name: Codex plus deterministic validators and live browser proof

contractChecks.evidence: Phase A is approved and canonical; Phase B is now the active subphase under its separate functional proof gate.
Thirty-two hierarchy-locked candidates span landing plates, two reusable card anatomies, bounded bundle relationships and realistic website sections.
All 32 studies render the canonical registry at runtime; public product name precedes the canonical extended system name and product count is not hardcoded.
Each product owns a proof primitive — run, graph, campaign, session, cadence — with a declared default for future products; the verifier cross-checks assignments against registry slugs.
MN01, MN02, HS01 and HS02 are absent from the component registry, workbench navigation, review UI and active expression contract.
IntersectionObserver moves the single Deep Mineral No. 5 allocation automatically to the dominant visible animated pane; no animation button exists and static fallbacks remain exact material twins.
Charcoal rooms are token remaps of #171715/#1B1B19/#252523; charcoal objects use #2E2E2E; no pure black.
Contract, package and review record confer production authority only on the approved Phase A visual grammar; canonical dependency hashes remain pinned and Phase B components remain non-authoritative.
H-EXP-04A-CARD-VISUAL-DIRECTION closed with 32 keeps and explicit instruction to proceed.

qualityDimensions.evidence: Four active jobs expose 32 hierarchy-locked candidates after removing all four killed Round 09 editions.
Living Core material leads every composition while typography, Wings and rounded chassis preserve a shared Mez identity.
Animated versions run by default when focal, the one allocation moves rather than multiplies, and repeated family objects stay intentionally static.
Registry-driven rendering, default territory primitive and count-independent collections demonstrate growth beyond five products.
Ten rounds of receipts, unanimous approval, explicit negative boundaries, a decision record and a permanent regression proof make the visual authority and Phase B boundary auditable.

notes: Phase A is complete: machine validation, live browser proof and human approval all pass.
The approved visual grammar is documented in PRODUCT-CARD-DESIGN-ETHOS.md and must be inherited by Phase B.
Phase B requires its own future human review before any functional component receives production authority.
